image_title: Infosys Consolidated Financial Data - Third Quarter, Fiscal 2026
summary: This document is a fact sheet from Infosys detailing consolidated financial data for the third quarter of fiscal 2026. It includes tables on effort and utilization metrics for IT services, employee metrics, and cash metrics. The effort and utilization section shows percentages for onsite and offshore efforts, as well as utilization rates including and excluding trainees. Employee metrics provide numbers on total employees, software professionals, sales and support staff, voluntary attrition percentage, and the percentage of women employees. Cash metrics are presented in both US dollars and Indian rupees, detailing free cash flow (FCF), adjustments for labor codes, adjusted FCF, and consolidated cash and investments. Key insights include trends in employee numbers and cash flow adjustments over the specified quarters.
